verdict.rationale: The product has no llms.txt of its own: the only llms.txt probe hit GitHub's generic platform file, and the docs-md probe for the repo returned 404. However, the product is itself made of agent-oriented markdown. Its SKILL.md files are served raw (tdd, grilling, triage, setup), it keeps agent ADRs under `.agents/`, and it offers a skill for choosing which skill to use, so an agent can be pointed directly at these files. Missing for 10: a product-specific llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a markdown docs endpoint for the project/site, and independent confirmation that agents can navigate the docs this way.
